Per this repository's AI-contribution policy it requires the `llm-generated` label; a cross-fork author cannot apply labels, so maintainers are kindly asked to add it. Validation evidence is below.
prBodyContract.footerTemplate: Opened by the warren campaign controller from a journaled, owner-approved cross-fork intent (campaign `{campaignId}`). The exact request was journaled before any posting; when the campaign policy does not enable the create mutation, this body exists only as dry-run evidence and no pull request is opened.

norms: Produce the smallest possible diff that resolves the issue; scope changes to what the reviewed issue actually requires.
Write behavior-focused unit tests for the fix: assert observable behavior, never implementation details.
Never stringify LLMMessage.content with str(); collapse message content to text with the message_content_text helper from crewai.utilities.agent_utils.
Never modify files under docs/v*/ or docs/images/ — those are frozen release snapshots managed by devtools; current docs live under docs/edge/en/ and register in docs/docs.json.
Use Conventional Commits for every commit message and the PR title (feat|fix|docs|refactor|perf|test|chore with a scope), for example fix(llms): map default context window.
Run the repository's own gates before finishing: uv run pytest on the touched test files, plus the configured pre-commit hooks; keep changes DRY and YAGNI.
State unprovable claims as known gaps rather than omitting them; silent omissions are harder for review to catch than declared uncertainty.
